name: OpenAPI
description: Connects Drupal to the OpenAPI Javascript Library

suggests.drupal/openapi_ui: Provides a web UI (e.g. ReDoc, Swagger UI) for exploring the generated OpenAPI specification; required only for the openapi.documentation route.

project_description:
This module allows you to make your Drupal information architecture (as exposed by your web service of choice) discoverable using the OpenAPI standard. This can then be used by a wide variety of UI, SDK generator and other tools to inspect, integrate and test your web services.

 This module provides core functionality for OpenAPI specification generation. Most likely, you will want to install a dependent module which will generate a spec for the flavor of web service implemented by your site:

 
 JSON:API 
 REST 
 
 Version notes 
 Version 2.x of this Drupal module implements version 2 of the Open API specification.

 Version 3.x of this module implements version 3.x of the Open API specification . This branch is currently dependent on patches to Drupal core.
